screen.rationale: Primary study; LDPE and HDPE films with green-synthesised ZnO/Fe3O4 under natural sunlight for 30 days (passes E3), but outcomes are only gravimetric weight loss (e.g. LDPE 27% with ZnO), CO2-C evolved / mineralization % (Table 3), FTIR, SEM/EDS and pH; no molar mass and no identified organic product quantified (CO2 evolution is excluded under E5).

excluded_observations.what: Mass loss and CO2-C evolved / mineralization % (Table 3); weight loss (Table 2)
excluded_observations.why: Mass loss and CO2 evolution are excluded under E5.
